q22133.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates that snow ploughs are working on the road.

explain.short: The snowflake and the snow plough mean snow ploughs are at work on this road.
explain.rule: This panel goes under the 'altri pericoli' (other dangers) sign on snowy roads. Snow ploughs are working: slow down and keep at least 20 metres from them.
explain.trap: 'sgombraneve al lavoro' is exactly what the drawing shows.

q22134.en: The supplementary panel shown is paired with the OTHER DANGERS sign.

explain.short: This panel explains the generic danger sign 'altri pericoli', saying which danger: snow ploughs.
explain.rule: This panel goes under the 'altri pericoli' (other dangers) sign on snowy roads. Snow ploughs are working: slow down and keep at least 20 metres from them.
explain.trap: 'ALTRI PERICOLI' is the triangle with an exclamation mark; the panel says what the danger is.

q22135.en: The supplementary panel shown asks you to reduce speed because snow ploughs are operating.

explain.short: Snow ploughs are slow and throw snow: the panel warns you to slow down.
explain.rule: This panel goes under the 'altri pericoli' (other dangers) sign on snowy roads. Snow ploughs are working: slow down and keep at least 20 metres from them.
explain.trap: 'invita a diminuire la velocità' is the right reaction to any danger panel.

q22136.en: The supplementary panel shown asks you to keep a distance of at least 20 metres from snow ploughs in operation.

explain.short: A working snow plough throws snow and may stop suddenly: you keep at least 20 metres behind it.
explain.rule: This panel goes under the 'altri pericoli' (other dangers) sign on snowy roads. Snow ploughs are working: slow down and keep at least 20 metres from them.
explain.trap: 'almeno 20 metri' is the official distance; the quiz may try 100 metres.

sceneParams.caption: Keep at least 20 m from the plough

q22136.reviewNote: The '20 metres' from working snow ploughs comes from the official quiz; I found no explicit number for this panel in the Codice text I know.

q22137.en: The supplementary panel shown tells you to watch out for snow ploughs on the road.

explain.short: It is a danger panel: it asks for attention because snow ploughs may be on the road.
explain.rule: This panel goes under the 'altri pericoli' (other dangers) sign on snowy roads. Snow ploughs are working: slow down and keep at least 20 metres from them.
explain.trap: 'prestare attenzione' (pay attention) fits every danger panel.

q22138.en: The supplementary panel shown is placed on snowy roads to signal the presence of snow ploughs.

explain.short: Snow ploughs work where there is snow, so the panel is placed on snow-covered roads.
explain.rule: This panel goes under the 'altri pericoli' (other dangers) sign on snowy roads. Snow ploughs are working: slow down and keep at least 20 metres from them.
explain.trap: 'strade innevate' (snowy roads) is exactly where snow ploughs work.

q22139.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates the building of a playground nearby.

explain.short: The drawing is a snowflake and a snow plough, not a playground.
explain.rule: This panel goes under the 'altri pericoli' (other dangers) sign on snowy roads. Snow ploughs are working: slow down and keep at least 20 metres from them.
explain.trap: 'parco giochi' (playground) has nothing to do with this picture.

sceneParams.caption: Not a playground: snow ploughs at work

q22140.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates no entry for snow ploughs.

explain.short: The panel warns that snow ploughs ARE working on the road; it does not ban them.
explain.rule: This panel goes under the 'altri pericoli' (other dangers) sign on snowy roads. Snow ploughs are working: slow down and keep at least 20 metres from them.
explain.trap: 'divieto di transito' is a ban; this panel is only a warning.

sceneParams.caption: A warning, not a ban for snow ploughs

q22141.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates that you must fit snow chains.

explain.short: The panel only warns of snow ploughs at work; chains are ordered by a different, round blue sign.
explain.rule: This panel goes under the 'altri pericoli' (other dangers) sign on snowy roads. Snow ploughs are working: slow down and keep at least 20 metres from them.
explain.trap: 'obbligo di montare le catene' is a different sign, not this panel.

sceneParams.caption: Snow ploughs, not a chains order

q22142.en: The supplementary panel shown requires you to stay 100 metres away from an operating snow plough.

explain.short: The distance to keep from a working snow plough is at least 20 metres, not 100.
explain.rule: This panel goes under the 'altri pericoli' (other dangers) sign on snowy roads. Snow ploughs are working: slow down and keep at least 20 metres from them.
explain.trap: '100 metri' is the wrong number: the right one is 20 metres.

q22143.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates that the road can be used only after the snow plough has passed.

explain.short: The road stays open: the panel only warns that snow ploughs are working, so you drive carefully.
explain.rule: This panel goes under the 'altri pericoli' (other dangers) sign on snowy roads. Snow ploughs are working: slow down and keep at least 20 metres from them.
explain.trap: 'solo dopo' (only after) invents a closure that the panel does not say.

q22144.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates that on the road you may meet the rubbish collection vehicle.

explain.short: The drawing is a snow plough with a snowflake, not a rubbish lorry.
explain.rule: This panel goes under the 'altri pericoli' (other dangers) sign on snowy roads. Snow ploughs are working: slow down and keep at least 20 metres from them.
explain.trap: 'raccolta della spazzatura' (rubbish collection) is not what the drawing shows.

sceneParams.caption: Snow plough, not a rubbish lorry

q22145.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates a road that can flood in heavy rain.

explain.short: The blue wavy lines are water: in heavy rain this road can be flooded.
explain.rule: The panel with blue wavy lines warns that this stretch of road can flood (allagarsi) with heavy rain or a strong sea storm.
explain.trap: 'si può allagare' (can flood) is the exact meaning of the waves.

sceneParams.caption: This road can flood in heavy rain

q22146.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates that we are driving on a stretch of road that can flood in heavy rain.

explain.short: The wavy lines warn that this stretch can be covered by water when it rains hard.
explain.rule: The panel with blue wavy lines warns that this stretch of road can flood (allagarsi) with heavy rain or a strong sea storm.
explain.trap: 'tratto di strada' (stretch of road): the danger is on the stretch you are driving on.

q22147.en: The sign shown indicates that the road can flood in heavy rain.

explain.short: Under the 'strada deformata' (uneven road) triangle, the wavy-lines panel adds that the road can flood in heavy rain.
explain.rule: The panel with blue wavy lines warns that this stretch of road can flood (allagarsi) with heavy rain or a strong sea storm.
explain.trap: Look at the panel under the triangle: 'si può allagare' comes from the waves.

sceneParams.caption: Uneven road that can also flood

q22148.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates the danger of the carriageway flooding in case of rain or a strong sea storm.

explain.short: Water can cover the road both from heavy rain and from big sea waves near the coast.
explain.rule: The panel with blue wavy lines warns that this stretch of road can flood (allagarsi) with heavy rain or a strong sea storm.
explain.trap: 'mareggiata' (sea storm) is also a cause of flooding, so it fits.

sceneParams.caption: Flooding from rain or sea storm

q22149.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates a swimming pool nearby.

explain.short: The waves warn that the road can flood; they are not a swimming pool.
explain.rule: The panel with blue wavy lines warns that this stretch of road can flood (allagarsi) with heavy rain or a strong sea storm.
explain.trap: 'piscina' (swimming pool) is a tourist idea, not a danger panel.

sceneParams.caption: Not a pool: the road can flood

q22150.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates a stretch of road covered with snow.

explain.short: Blue waves mean water and flooding; snow is shown with snowflakes.
explain.rule: The panel with blue wavy lines warns that this stretch of road can flood (allagarsi) with heavy rain or a strong sea storm.
explain.trap: 'coperto di neve' (covered with snow) does not match blue waves.

q22151.en: The supplementary panel shown gives advance warning of a soft verge.

explain.short: A soft verge has its own triangle sign; the waves warn of flooding.
explain.rule: The panel with blue wavy lines warns that this stretch of road can flood (allagarsi) with heavy rain or a strong sea storm.
explain.trap: 'banchina cedevole' (soft verge) is a different sign.

q22152.en: The supplementary panel shown bans vehicles carrying products that could pollute the water.

explain.short: This is a danger panel about flooding, not a ban; the ban for polluting goods is a different round sign.
explain.rule: The panel with blue wavy lines warns that this stretch of road can flood (allagarsi) with heavy rain or a strong sea storm.
explain.trap: 'vieta il transito' (bans): a white panel with waves bans nothing.

sceneParams.caption: A flood warning, not a ban

q22153.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates a stretch of road where you may find fog.

explain.short: The blue waves are water on the road, not fog.
explain.rule: The panel with blue wavy lines warns that this stretch of road can flood (allagarsi) with heavy rain or a strong sea storm.
explain.trap: 'nebbia' (fog) is not what the wavy lines mean.

q22154.en: The supplementary panel shown gives advance warning of transverse slowing-down strips (artificial humps).

explain.short: Speed humps have their own 'dosso' sign; the blue waves mean the road can flood.
explain.rule: The panel with blue wavy lines warns that this stretch of road can flood (allagarsi) with heavy rain or a strong sea storm.
explain.trap: 'dossi artificiali' (speed humps): the waves are water, not bumps.

q22155.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates that you may find heavy traffic, with queues of vehicles forming.

explain.short: The many cars in rows show heavy traffic and queues.
explain.rule: The panel with many cars in rows warns of heavy traffic and queues of slow or stopped vehicles. Slow down and keep your distance.
explain.trap: 'formazione di colonne' (queues forming) is exactly the drawing.

q22156.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates that you may find vehicles stopped in a queue.

explain.short: In a queue cars can be standing still, and the panel warns you of this.
explain.rule: The panel with many cars in rows warns of heavy traffic and queues of slow or stopped vehicles. Slow down and keep your distance.
explain.trap: 'veicoli fermi in colonna' (vehicles stopped in a queue) is part of the meaning.

sceneParams.caption: Stopped cars in a queue ahead

q22157.en: The supplementary panel shown can be found at motorway entrances, to show that there are slow-moving vehicles.

explain.short: Before you enter the motorway, the panel can warn that traffic inside is slow.
explain.rule: The panel with many cars in rows warns of heavy traffic and queues of slow or stopped vehicles. Slow down and keep your distance.
explain.trap: 'all'ingresso delle autostrade' is a real place for this panel.

q22158.en: The supplementary panel shown asks you to be careful, so as not to run into the back of vehicles stopped by a traffic jam.

explain.short: Cars at the end of a queue may be stopped: drive carefully so you do not hit them from behind.
explain.rule: The panel with many cars in rows warns of heavy traffic and queues of slow or stopped vehicles. Slow down and keep your distance.
explain.trap: 'tamponare' means hitting the car in front from behind.

sceneParams.caption: Careful: do not hit stopped cars

q22159.en: The supplementary panel shown, placed on the motorway, can advise you to exit to avoid likely slowdowns or queues.

explain.short: On the motorway the queue panel can suggest leaving at the next exit to avoid the queue.
explain.rule: The panel with many cars in rows warns of heavy traffic and queues of slow or stopped vehicles. Slow down and keep your distance.
explain.trap: 'può consigliare' (can advise): it is advice, not an order.

sceneParams.caption: Motorway: exit to avoid the queue

q22160.en: The panel shown indicates a parking area for cars.

explain.short: The cars are in rows because they are in a queue, not parked; parking has the blue 'P' sign.
explain.rule: The panel with many cars in rows warns of heavy traffic and queues of slow or stopped vehicles. Slow down and keep your distance.
explain.trap: 'area di parcheggio' (parking area) is shown with a 'P', not with this drawing.

q22161.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates that the left lane is reserved for vehicles paying the motorway toll by Telepass.

explain.short: The panel warns of queues; it says nothing about toll lanes.
explain.rule: The panel with many cars in rows warns of heavy traffic and queues of slow or stopped vehicles. Slow down and keep your distance.
explain.trap: 'riservata' (reserved) and 'telepass' are toll-booth ideas, not this panel.

sceneParams.caption: Queue warning, not a Telepass lane

q22162.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates a one-way road.

explain.short: The cars all go the same way because they are queuing; one-way has its own blue arrow sign.
explain.rule: The panel with many cars in rows warns of heavy traffic and queues of slow or stopped vehicles. Slow down and keep your distance.
explain.trap: 'senso unico' (one-way) is a different sign.

q22163.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates that you must overtake on the left.

explain.short: A danger panel gives no orders: it only warns of queues.
explain.rule: The panel with many cars in rows warns of heavy traffic and queues of slow or stopped vehicles. Slow down and keep your distance.
explain.trap: 'obbligo' (obligation): a warning panel never creates an obligation.

sceneParams.caption: A warning, not an overtaking order

q22164.en: The supplementary panel shown tells you to reduce the safety distance.

explain.short: With queues ahead you need MORE space to stop, not less.
explain.rule: The panel with many cars in rows warns of heavy traffic and queues of slow or stopped vehicles. Slow down and keep your distance.
explain.trap: 'diminuire' (reduce) is the opposite of what is safe.

q22165.en: The supplementary panel shown requires vehicles to drive at walking pace.

explain.short: The panel warns of queues and asks for care; it does not set a fixed speed.
explain.rule: The panel with many cars in rows warns of heavy traffic and queues of slow or stopped vehicles. Slow down and keep your distance.
explain.trap: 'obbliga' and 'passo d'uomo' (walking pace) add an order the panel does not give.

q22166.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates that moving work machines may be present.

explain.short: The digger drawing warns that work machines may be moving on the road.
explain.rule: The panel with a digger warns that work machines (excavators, mechanical shovels) may be moving on the road, usually at road works. Take special care.
explain.trap: 'macchine operatrici' are work machines like diggers and shovels.

q22167.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates that there may be mechanical shovels working in the lane.

explain.short: The drawing is a mechanical shovel: it may be working in the lane.
explain.rule: The panel with a digger warns that work machines (excavators, mechanical shovels) may be moving on the road, usually at road works. Take special care.
explain.trap: 'pale meccaniche' (mechanical shovels) is the machine in the drawing.

sceneParams.caption: Mechanical shovels may be at work

q22168.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates that there may be excavators moving on the road.

explain.short: Excavators are work machines, and the panel warns they may be moving.
explain.rule: The panel with a digger warns that work machines (excavators, mechanical shovels) may be moving on the road, usually at road works. Take special care.
explain.trap: 'escavatori' (excavators) are included in 'macchine operatrici'.

q22169.en: The supplementary panel shown asks you to be especially careful because of moving mechanical shovels.

explain.short: Moving work machines are a danger, so you drive with special care.
explain.rule: The panel with a digger warns that work machines (excavators, mechanical shovels) may be moving on the road, usually at road works. Take special care.
explain.trap: 'particolare prudenza' (special care) is the right reaction to a danger panel.

q22170.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates road works with excavators and mechanical shovels in action.

explain.short: These machines are usually at road works, and the panel warns they are working.
explain.rule: The panel with a digger warns that work machines (excavators, mechanical shovels) may be moving on the road, usually at road works. Take special care.
explain.trap: 'cantieri stradali' (road works) is where these machines usually work.

sceneParams.caption: Road works with diggers in action

q22171.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates the presence of military vehicles.

explain.short: The drawing is a digger, a work machine, not an army vehicle.
explain.rule: The panel with a digger warns that work machines (excavators, mechanical shovels) may be moving on the road, usually at road works. Take special care.
explain.trap: 'veicoli militari' (military vehicles): tracks do not make it a tank.

q22172.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates an area for dumping rubbish.

explain.short: The panel warns of moving work machines; it does not show a rubbish area.
explain.rule: The panel with a digger warns that work machines (excavators, mechanical shovels) may be moving on the road, usually at road works. Take special care.
explain.trap: 'scarico della spazzatura' (rubbish dumping) is not what the digger means.

sceneParams.caption: Work machines, not a rubbish area

q22173.en: The supplementary panel shown is found before a bridge, to ban work machines from crossing.

explain.short: This is a danger panel, not a ban: it warns that work machines are moving.
explain.rule: The panel with a digger warns that work machines (excavators, mechanical shovels) may be moving on the road, usually at road works. Take special care.
explain.trap: 'vietare il transito' (to ban): the panel warns, it does not forbid.

sceneParams.caption: A warning, not a ban for machines

q22174.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates a road reserved only for work machines.

explain.short: The road is open to everyone; the panel only warns that work machines may be on it.
explain.rule: The panel with a digger warns that work machines (excavators, mechanical shovels) may be moving on the road, usually at road works. Take special care.
explain.trap: 'riservata alle sole' (reserved only for) invents a rule the panel does not give.

sceneParams.caption: Open road: just watch for machines

q22175.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates no entry for all tracked vehicles.

explain.short: The tracked digger is the danger you may meet; the panel bans no vehicle.
explain.rule: The panel with a digger warns that work machines (excavators, mechanical shovels) may be moving on the road, usually at road works. Take special care.
explain.trap: 'divieto di transito' (no transit): a danger panel is not a ban.

sceneParams.caption: Warning, not a ban on tracks

q22176.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates a parking area reserved for work machines.

explain.short: The machines are moving and working, not parked; the panel warns of danger.
explain.rule: The panel with a digger warns that work machines (excavators, mechanical shovels) may be moving on the road, usually at road works. Take special care.
explain.trap: 'area di parcheggio' (parking area) is a 'P' sign, not this panel.

sceneParams.caption: Moving machines, not a car park

q22177.en: The sign shown indicates that you may find a stretch of road that is slippery because of ice.

explain.short: The skidding-car triangle means slippery road, and the snowflake panel says why: ice.
explain.rule: The blue panel with two snowflakes warns that the road can be icy and slippery when the temperature is low. Take special care.
explain.trap: 'a causa di ghiaccio' (because of ice) comes from the blue snowflake panel.

q22178.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates that you may find icy stretches of road.

explain.short: The blue panel with snowflakes warns of ice on the road.
explain.rule: The blue panel with two snowflakes warns that the road can be icy and slippery when the temperature is low. Take special care.
explain.trap: 'ghiacciati' (icy) is the meaning of the snowflakes here.

q22179.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates, when the temperature is low, the presence of stretches made dangerous by ice.

explain.short: When it is cold, water on the road can freeze: the panel warns of these icy stretches.
explain.rule: The blue panel with two snowflakes warns that the road can be icy and slippery when the temperature is low. Take special care.
explain.trap: 'bassa temperatura' (low temperature) is when ice forms.

q22180.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates, on snow-covered roads, the danger of ice forming.

explain.short: Snow on the road can turn into ice, and the panel warns of this danger.
explain.rule: The blue panel with two snowflakes warns that the road can be icy and slippery when the temperature is low. Take special care.
explain.trap: 'formazione di ghiaccio' (ice forming) is exactly the danger shown.

q22181.en: The supplementary panel shown asks you to be especially careful, because the road may be icy.

explain.short: Ice makes the car slide easily, so the panel asks for special care.
explain.rule: The blue panel with two snowflakes warns that the road can be icy and slippery when the temperature is low. Take special care.
explain.trap: 'particolare prudenza' (special care) is the right reaction to ice.

sceneParams.caption: Special care: road may be icy

q22182.en: The sign shown indicates a road slippery because of ice, when the temperature is low.

explain.short: Slippery-road triangle plus snowflake panel: the road can be icy when it is cold.
explain.rule: The blue panel with two snowflakes warns that the road can be icy and slippery when the temperature is low. Take special care.
explain.trap: 'per ghiaccio' (because of ice) comes from the snowflake panel under the triangle.

q22183.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates ski lifts nearby.

explain.short: The snowflakes warn of ice on the road, not of skiing facilities.
explain.rule: The blue panel with two snowflakes warns that the road can be icy and slippery when the temperature is low. Take special care.
explain.trap: 'impianti di risalita' (ski lifts) is a tourist sign, not a danger panel.

q22184.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates the road to take to reach the Alps.

explain.short: It is a warning about ice, not a direction sign.
explain.rule: The blue panel with two snowflakes warns that the road can be icy and slippery when the temperature is low. Take special care.
explain.trap: 'la strada da prendere' (the road to take) is what direction signs do, not this panel.

q22185.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates a ski resort nearby.

explain.short: The snowflakes mean ice on the road, not a place to ski.
explain.rule: The blue panel with two snowflakes warns that the road can be icy and slippery when the temperature is low. Take special care.
explain.trap: 'stazione sciistica' (ski resort) is not what the panel means.

q22186.en: The supplementary panel shown asks you to use the hazard lights when stopped.

explain.short: The panel warns of ice while you drive; it says nothing about lights when stopping.
explain.rule: The blue panel with two snowflakes warns that the road can be icy and slippery when the temperature is low. Take special care.
explain.trap: 'luci di emergenza' (hazard lights) are not mentioned by this panel.

q22187.en: The supplementary panel shown asks you not to use high beams.

explain.short: The snowflakes warn of ice; they give no rule about headlights.
explain.rule: The blue panel with two snowflakes warns that the road can be icy and slippery when the temperature is low. Take special care.
explain.trap: 'fari abbaglianti' (high beams) have nothing to do with this panel.

sceneParams.caption: Ice warning, not a headlight rule

q22188.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates an area where it often snows.

explain.short: The panel warns that the road can be icy, not that snow falls often.
explain.rule: The blue panel with two snowflakes warns that the road can be icy and slippery when the temperature is low. Take special care.
explain.trap: 'nevica spesso' (it often snows) is weather, not the road danger shown.

q22189.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates a stretch of road that is dangerous in case of rain.

explain.short: The cloud and rain show that this stretch becomes dangerous when it rains.
explain.rule: The panel with a cloud and rain warns that this stretch becomes slippery when it rains. Slow down and keep a bigger safety distance.
explain.trap: 'in caso di pioggia' (in case of rain) is exactly the drawing.

q22190.en: The supplementary panel shown asks you, in case of rain, to increase the safety distance.

explain.short: On a wet, slippery road you need more space to stop, so you keep a bigger distance.
explain.rule: The panel with a cloud and rain warns that this stretch becomes slippery when it rains. Slow down and keep a bigger safety distance.
explain.trap: 'aumentare la distanza' (increase the distance) is correct on a slippery road.

q22191.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates that when it rains the road may become slippery.

explain.short: Rain makes this stretch slippery, and the panel warns of it.
explain.rule: The panel with a cloud and rain warns that this stretch becomes slippery when it rains. Slow down and keep a bigger safety distance.
explain.trap: 'sdrucciolevole' means slippery.

q22192.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates that in case of rain you may find mud on the road.

explain.short: Rain can carry mud onto the road, which makes it even more slippery.
explain.rule: The panel with a cloud and rain warns that this stretch becomes slippery when it rains. Slow down and keep a bigger safety distance.
explain.trap: 'fango' (mud) is one of the reasons the road gets slippery in the rain.

sceneParams.caption: Rain can bring mud on the road

q22193.en: The supplementary panel shown signals a stretch of road that is slippery in case of rain.

explain.short: Cloud and rain on the panel mean the stretch is slippery when it rains.
explain.rule: The panel with a cloud and rain warns that this stretch becomes slippery when it rains. Slow down and keep a bigger safety distance.
explain.trap: 'sdrucciolevole in caso di pioggia' (slippery in rain) is the official name of this panel.

q22194.en: The supplementary panel shown asks you to reduce speed in case of rain, because the road becomes slippery.

explain.short: On a slippery road you must go slower, so the panel asks you to reduce speed.
explain.rule: The panel with a cloud and rain warns that this stretch becomes slippery when it rains. Slow down and keep a bigger safety distance.
explain.trap: 'diminuire la velocità' (reduce speed) is the right answer to a slippery road.

q22195.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates a car wash nearby.

explain.short: The cloud and rain warn of a slippery road, not of a car wash.
explain.rule: The panel with a cloud and rain warns that this stretch becomes slippery when it rains. Slow down and keep a bigger safety distance.
explain.trap: 'autolavaggio' (car wash): water on the panel is rain, not a service.

sceneParams.caption: Rain danger, not a car wash

q22196.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates a weather station nearby.

explain.short: The cloud warns of a road slippery in the rain; it does not show a weather station.
explain.rule: The panel with a cloud and rain warns that this stretch becomes slippery when it rains. Slow down and keep a bigger safety distance.
explain.trap: 'stazione meteorologica' (weather station) is not a road danger.

sceneParams.caption: Rain danger, not a weather station

q22197.en: The supplementary panel shown tells you to watch out for passing lorries, because they may lose their load.

explain.short: The dashes are rain falling from a cloud, not goods falling from lorries.
explain.rule: The panel with a cloud and rain warns that this stretch becomes slippery when it rains. Slow down and keep a bigger safety distance.
explain.trap: 'perdita del carico' (loss of load) misreads the falling rain.

q22198.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates a stretch of road where dust clouds are likely.

explain.short: The dark cloud is a rain cloud, not dust.
explain.rule: The panel with a cloud and rain warns that this stretch becomes slippery when it rains. Slow down and keep a bigger safety distance.
explain.trap: 'nuvole di polvere' (dust clouds) misreads the rain cloud.

q22199.en: The panel shown indicates an area where it often rains.

explain.short: The panel warns that the road is slippery WHEN it rains; it does not describe the local weather.
explain.rule: The panel with a cloud and rain warns that this stretch becomes slippery when it rains. Slow down and keep a bigger safety distance.
explain.trap: 'piove spesso' (it often rains) is about weather, not the road danger.

sceneParams.caption: Slippery in rain, not 'it often rains'

q22200.en: The supplementary panel shown indicates falling rocks on the road.

explain.short: Falling rocks have their own triangle sign; this panel shows rain from a cloud.
explain.rule: The panel with a cloud and rain warns that this stretch becomes slippery when it rains. Slow down and keep a bigger safety distance.
explain.trap: 'caduta di pietre' (falling rocks) misreads the rain drops.
